usage: deskops list tasks [-h] [--root ROOT] [--include-repos]
                          [--format {text,json}]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Target repository root.
  --include-repos       Also list tasks routed by registered sibling
                        repositories' desk/tasks/Board.md files.
  --format {text,json}  Output format.
